title: T-1667 verification follow-ups V1-V4 (next_goal after model close, enabled_at reset, CLI shutdown joins ship, stale post-merge gate)
spec:
Four findings from the final verification of goal/T-1667 (2026-10-07). Fix each with a named test.
V1 medium planner_runs.py:283,285 next_goal fires only when pipeline.closed_at is set, which only routine_close stamps
   (planner_runs.py ~1654). A goal closed by a model Planner never leads to next_goal. Fix: stamp closed_at wherever
   result.goal_closed is posted (bus/post path or the model-close path), and in next_goal fall back to the goal_closed
   event time (planner_telemetry.goal_closed_at) when closed_at is missing. test_next_goal_after_model_close.
V2 low planner_runs.py:254-272 enabled_at is never cleared, so off-then-on makes goals closed while off eligible. Delete
   .orchestrator/next_goal_state.json when next_goal is seen disabled. test_reenable_resets_enabled_at.
V3 low daemon.py:2110-2114 the CLI daemon passes an Event that is never set; after Ctrl-C the non-daemon ship thread runs
   on to gh pr merge while daemon.lock is released, and the watchdog still sees a matching pid. Keep the Event, set it in
   main's finally, then ship.join_threads() (bounded wait, then log) before releasing the lock.
   test_cli_shutdown_stops_ship_thread_before_lock_release.
V4 low ship.py:368 the reset to gating when a merged PR no longer covers the goal keeps the old post_merge_gate and
   merge_sha; clear both in that update (or key post_merge_gate by the merge sha it ran on and compare).
   test_reset_to_gating_clears_post_merge_state.
Run: PYTHONPATH=tests uv run python -m unittest tests.test_ship tests.test_next_goal tests.test_daemon. Commit on the task branch.
acceptance: each of V1-V4 has its named test and it passes

result.summary:
**Summary:** I didn't implement V1-V4. T-1704 is on hold on the bus with reason `base_mismatch`.

The code these fixes target isn't on the branch this task starts from. The packet's base is 247fe58 (main), but `orchestrator/ship.py`, `tests/test_ship.py`, `tests/test_next_goal.py` and the next_goal/`enabled_at` logic in `planner_runs.py` only exist on `goal/T-1667` (tip be223f5). That branch hasn't been merged into main. If I built on it, all of T-1667's commits would end up in this task's diff, outside write_scope, and they would merge into goal/T-1703.

**What changed:** I only fast-forwarded the task branch from 6cbc778 to the declared base 247fe58. The tree is clean and I made no commits.

**What's left:** the Planner needs to pick one of these, then re-dispatch:
- re-base T-1703/T-1704 on `goal/T-1667`
- run V1-V4 as a fix round on `goal/T-1667`
- merge `goal/T-1667` to main first

**Files changed:** none.

**Tests:** I didn't run them, since nothing changed.
